headline: Asian Stocks Rebound Led by Tech Shares and Strong Export Data
summary: Asian shares climbed, with the Nikkei 225 and South Korean stocks rebounding as technology shares rallied and Japan reported a jump in exports.
why: Regional equity performance reflects broader sentiment trends in global technology spending and international trade health.

impacts.name: Asian Technology
impacts.why: Spillover buying from Wall Street earnings optimism lifts regional semiconductor and technology equities.

why_moved: Positive Wall Street earnings reports and easing artificial intelligence spending concerns improved investor risk appetite across Asian bourses.
